title: Compliance milestone sprint map and evidence handback flow
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: produce a sprint-by-sprint milestone map for SOC2/ISO readiness focused on structured evidence handback to customers and auditors. This ticket defines the handback flow (who provides which artifact, format/retention, automated evidence export points), sprint-level owners, gating criteria for each milestone, and a lightweight playbook for handling auditor requests during cutover windows. Scope: controls that touch SSO/SAML onboarding, tenant-scoped audit log retention, access control evidence, and encryption/KMS attestations. Excludes: full control remediation work (separate ENG tickets) and legal contract negotiation. Deliverables: 1) milestone map (week-by-week) with owners and acceptance criteria, 2) evidence handback flow diagram and sample templates, 3) automation gaps list and recommended quick wins for Cycle 52, 4) readiness checklist for enterprise onboarding teams.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone map covering next 6 sprints with named owners and contingency owners
Evidence handback flow diagram reviewed and approved by Security and Compliance (at least 2 reviewers)
Templates for audit evidence exports (CSV/NDJSON + signed manifest) created and validated against internal retention policy
Automations backlog prioritized with at least 3 quick-win tickets created in ENG backlog
Playbook for responding to auditor inquiries documented and tested in a dry-run with customer success
progress_updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff with PM/Sec/Eng. Defined scope and candidate milestones. Agreed to focus on SSO, audit logs, and KMS proof points first.
2026-03-03: Security provided control matrix extract. Identified 12 evidence artifacts required for SOC2 readiness across infra and app layers.
2026-03-05: Eng lead (Priya Sharma) confirmed two automation approaches: scheduled export and on-demand bundle. Chose to prototype scheduled export for quick wins.
2026-03-07: Draft milestone map created; blocked on audit retention confirmation from infra team (ENG-5983). Added retention questions to infra retro.
2026-03-09: Design scoping session with UX to create evidence manifest schema and human-readable handback template. Decided to include SHA256 checksums and generation timestamps.
2026-03-12: Security review meeting — Kevin Lee requested proof-of-concept for signed manifests; assigned ENG-6722 to prototype HMAC signature flow. Next: produce dry-run checklist for 2026-03-22.
comments: Kevin Lee (Security): Please ensure manifest signatures are rotatable and KMS-backed. We should avoid baking static keys into build artifacts.
Priya Sharma (Engineering): Prototype will use existing export pipeline; will add a flag for 'auditor_bundle' to include extra metadata. Estimate 3 pts for prototype.
Evelyn Cho (Customer Success): We need a short one-page handback doc that can be shared with customers during onboarding calls — we can reuse parts of the playbook.
Marco Ruiz (PM): Adding weekly sync with Sec and Eng to track blockers. If infra retention answers are delayed more than 5 business days, escalate to VP Eng.
audit_checklist: List of required artifacts per control with owner and retention period
Signed manifest schema and verification steps
Export cadence and storage location (S3 path with lifecycle policy)
Access review log proving who accessed the export bundle
On-call responder for auditor queries during cutover
rollout_plan: Week 1-2: Finalize milestone map and signoff with Security; kick off ENG prototyping for scheduled export
Week 3: Produce sample evidence bundles for two internal tenants and run verification against manifest schema
Week 4: Dry-run with Customer Success and Security simulating auditor request; collect feedback
Week 5-6: Address automation gaps, create ENG tickets for production rollout, and update onboarding docs
Post-release: Monitor exports for 2 sprints and capture metrics (time-to-generate, bundle size, verification failures)
